# Kevin Magnan

> Kevin J. Magnan is an AI engineer and educator (@vibewithkevin). He teaches tech-ish people to build with AI, using the same tools that run his own work every day. He is also Senior Principal, Justice and Public Safety at Slalom.

Usage policy lives in [robots.txt](https://kevinjmagnan.com/robots.txt). Search and live answer use are welcome. Training on this content is not permitted.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kevinjmagnan.com/): Who Kevin is, a demo that builds a page for each visitor, a free kit, featured builds, and videos. A Markdown copy is at [/index.md](https://kevinjmagnan.com/index.md), or request `/` with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- [Resume](https://kevinjmagnan.com/resume): Full work history, education, certifications, and skills.
- [Writing](https://kevinjmagnan.com/blog/): Every post, newest first. Writing on AI, public safety, and data.
- [Media kit](https://kevinjmagnan.com/media-kit/): Audience, reach, and partnership details for @vibewithkevin.

## Structured data

- [Robot view](https://kevinjmagnan.com/robot/): Person, work, and publication data rendered for machines, with JSON-LD.
- [Profile](https://kevinjmagnan.com/api/profile.json): Name, title, employer, and links.
- [Work](https://kevinjmagnan.com/api/work.json): Selected projects with tags and summaries.
- [Publications](https://kevinjmagnan.com/api/publications.json): Posts and articles with dates and summaries.
- [OpenAPI](https://kevinjmagnan.com/api/openapi.json): Description of the read endpoints above.

## Discovery

- [AI catalog](https://kevinjmagnan.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest.
- [API catalog](https://kevinjmagnan.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset of the endpoints above.
- [About Kevin skill](https://kevinjmagnan.com/.well-known/agent-skills/about-kevin/SKILL.md): Agent skill for answering questions about Kevin.
- [Sitemap](https://kevinjmagnan.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL.
